query: For my 60-year-old male patient, among male ICU patients aged 55–65, what's the SD of first MAP on ICU admission?
final_sql: SELECT stddev(p.value) AS standard_deviation FROM patients p JOIN icustays i ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id JOIN chartevents c ON i.stay_id = c.stay_id WHERE p.gender = 1 AND p.anchor_year = 60 AND i.first_careunit = 'ICU' AND c.itemid = 87167870 AND c.charttime BETWEEN i.intime AND i.outtime AND p.anchor_year BETWEEN 55 AND 65;
